The 
4 Nations 2026 Halloween Heist
 is an off-season tournament after the 2026 season of United Kingdom's amateur league, operated by 
UKEL
.

[
]


Format
[
]


Group Stage 1:

12 teams participate

6 from Division 2


6 from open qualifiers


4 groups


Double 
Round Robin


All matches are best of one


Winner of each group advances


Group Stage 2:

14 teams participate

10 from Division 1


4 from Group Stage 1


4 groups


Double 
Round Robin


All matches are best of one


Top 2 of each group advance


Playoffs:

Double elimination


Group winners start in the winner's bracket


Finals are best of five


All other matches are best of three

The 
2026 Benelux Ascend Series Summer Promotion
 ("
BAS 2026 Summer Promotion
") marks the second year of the Benelux 
League of Legends
 secondary circuit organized by 
Once Upon A Team
. It serves as a direct pathway to the 
Road Of Legends
. During the Summer Promotion, eight teams compete in a Swiss-style qualifier to participate in the Summer Split.

Overview
[
]


Format
[
]


Eight teams participate

Bottom two teams from the 
BAS 2026 Spring Regular Season


Bottom two teams from the 
BAS 2026 Spring Playoffs


Top four teams from the 
BAS Rising 2026 Spring Playoffs


Teams compete in up to three rounds of Swiss play

Teams with 2 wins qualify to the 
BAS 2026 Summer Split


Teams with 2 losses are eliminated


First round of Swiss is best-of-three (BO3)


Subsequent rounds are best-of-five (BO5)

The 
2026 Benelux Ascend Series Rising Summer Open Tournaments
 ("
BAS Rising 2026 Summer Open Tournaments
") marks the first year of the Benelux 
League of Legends
 tertiary open circuit organized by 
Once Upon A Team
. In open tournaments, teams compete in order to gain points towards qualification for the split's playoffs phase.

[
]

Five Rounds


Top 8 teams qualify to the Bracket Stage.


Bracket Stage

Single-Elimination


All matches are Best-of-Three (BO3)


Teams earn points depending on their overall placement in the tournament.

The 
2026 Benelux Ascend Series Summer Split
 ("
BAS 2026 Summer Split
") marks the second year of the Benelux 
League of Legends
 secondary circuit organized by 
Once Upon A Team
. It serves as a direct pathway to the 
Road Of Legends
. During the Summer Split, eight teams compete in a group stage format to attempt qualification for playoffs.

Overview
[
]


Format
[
]


Eight teams participate

Second-, Third-, and Fourth-seeded teams from the 
Spring Playoffs


Last-place team from the 
ROL 2026 Summer Promotion


Top four teams of the 
Summer Promotion


Single 
Round Robin


All matches are best-of-three (BO3)


Top six teams advance to 
playoffs


Top four teams are given a upper bracket berth


Seventh and eighth placed teams fall to the 
2027 Promotion Tournament

The 
2026 Benelux Ascend Series Summer Promotion
 ("
BAS 2026 Summer Promotion
") marks the second year of the Benelux 
League of Legends
 secondary circuit organized by 
Once Upon A Team
. It serves as a direct pathway to the 
Road Of Legends
. During the Summer Promotion, eight teams compete in a Swiss-style qualifier to participate in the Summer Split.

Overview
[
]


Format
[
]


Eight teams participate

Bottom two teams from the 
BAS 2026 Spring Regular Season


Bottom two teams from the 
BAS 2026 Spring Playoffs


Top four teams from the 
BAS Rising 2026 Spring Playoffs


Teams compete in up to three rounds of Swiss play

Teams with 2 wins qualify to the 
BAS 2026 Summer Split


Teams with 2 losses are eliminated


First round of Swiss is best-of-three (BO3)


Subsequent rounds are best-of-five (BO5)

The 
2027 Benelux Ascend Series Winter Promotion
 ("
BAS 2027 Winter Promotion
") marks the third year of the Benelux 
League of Legends
 secondary circuit organized by 
Once Upon A Team
. It serves as a direct pathway to the 
Road Of Legends
. During the Winter Promotion, eight teams compete in a Swiss-style qualifier to participate in the Winter Split.

Overview
[
]


Format
[
]


Eight teams participate

Bottom two teams from the 
BAS 2026 Summer Regular Season


Bottom two teams from the 
BAS 2026 Summer Playoffs


Top four teams from the 
BAS Rising 2026 Summer Playoffs


Teams compete in up to three rounds of Swiss play

Teams with 2 wins qualify to the 
BAS 2027 Winter Split


Teams with 2 losses are eliminated


First round of Swiss is best-of-three (BO3)


Subsequent rounds are best-of-five (BO5)

The 
2026 Benelux Ascend Series Summer Promotion
 ("
BAS 2026 Summer Promotion
") marks the second year of the Benelux 
League of Legends
 secondary circuit organized by 
Once Upon A Team
. It serves as a direct pathway to the 
Road Of Legends
. During the Summer Promotion, eight teams compete in a Swiss-style qualifier to participate in the Summer Split.

Overview
[
]


Format
[
]


Eight teams participate

Bottom two teams from the 
BAS 2026 Spring Regular Season


Bottom two teams from the 
BAS 2026 Spring Playoffs


Top four teams from the 
BAS Rising 2026 Spring Playoffs


Teams compete in up to three rounds of Swiss play

Teams with 2 wins qualify to the 
BAS 2026 Summer Split


Teams with 2 losses are eliminated


First round of Swiss is best-of-three (BO3)


Subsequent rounds are best-of-five (BO5)

2026 Benelux Ascend Series Rising Summer Open Tournaments
 ("
BAS Rising 2026 Summer Open Tournaments
") marks the first year of the Benelux 
League of Legends
 tertiary open circuit organized by 
Once Upon A Team
.  In open tournaments, teams compete in order to gain points towards qualification for the split's playoffs phase.

]

July 25th - 26th


August 8th - 9th


August 22nd - 23rd


Teams gain points from their placements in each tournaments.

The 6 teams with the most points qualify to the 
Playoffs Stage
.

The 
EMEA Masters 2026 Summer
 is the twentieth edition of Europe's premier semi-professional tournament englobing 13 
League of Legends
 
European Regional Leagues
 (ERL). Previously known as 
EU Masters
, this is the tenth edition of the tournament after uniting EU, TR, CIS, and MENA as the EMEA region. Each ERL send their best regional participants to represent their country and fight for regional pride. The 
EMEA Masters
 serve as the secondary layer of competitions underneath the 
LEC
.

32 teams participate

WSCI 2026

The 
EMEA Masters 2026 Spring
 is the nineteenth edition of Europe's premier semi-professional tournament englobing 13 
League of Legends
 
European Regional Leagues
 (ERL). Previously known as 
EU Masters
, this is the ninth edition of the tournament after uniting EU, TR, CIS, and MENA as the EMEA region. Each ERL send their best regional participants to represent their country and fight for regional pride. The 
EMEA Masters
 serve as the secondary layer of competitions underneath the 
LEC
.

All matches are best of three


The top two teams of each group advance to Playoffs

Previously known as '''EU Masters''', this is the tenth edition of the tournament after uniting EU, TR, CIS, and MENA as the EMEA region. Each ERL send their best regional participants to represent their country and fight for regional pride. The ''EMEA Masters'' serve as the secondary layer of competitions underneath the [[LoL European Championship|LEC]].}} ==Overview== === Format === * '''LCQ''' ** 16 teams participate ** Teams are divided into four groups of four ** Each group plays a GSL-style bracket ** All matches are best of three ** The top two teams of each group advance to the [[EMEA Masters/2026 Season/Summer Main Event|Main Event]] * '''Main Event''' ** '''Swiss Stage''' *** 32 teams participate **** 24 teams prequalified + the 8 qualifiers of the [[EMEA Masters/2026 Season/Summer LCQ|LCQ]] *** Swiss-style format with seven rounds *** Qualification and Elimination matches are best of three, all other matches are best of one *** Top 13 teams advance to Playoffs *** The teams finishing in 14th to 16th place advance to the Knockout Matches ** '''Knockout Matches''' *** 6 teams participate **** 3 EMEA teams from [[2026 World Star Challengers Invitational|WSCI 2026]] **** 3 teams ranked 14th to 16th from Swiss Stage *** All matches are best of five *** 3 teams advance to Playoffs ** '''Playoffs''' *** 16 teams participate **** 13 teams from Swiss Stage **** 3 teams from Knockout Matches *** Single elimination bracket *** All matches are best of five == Participants == * In the tables below, (Q) refers to the date on which the team qualified for EMEA Masters, while (Seed) refers to when the team was locked into their seed. The 
EMEA Masters 2026 Summer
 is the twentieth edition of Europe's premier semi-professional tournament englobing 13 
League of Legends
 
European Regional Leagues
 (ERL). Previously known as 
EU Masters
, this is the tenth edition of the tournament after uniting EU, TR, CIS, and MENA as the EMEA region. Each ERL send their best regional participants to represent their country and fight for regional pride. The 
EMEA Masters
 serve as the secondary layer of competitions underneath the 
LEC
.

Overview
[
]


Format
[
]


LCQ


16 teams participate


Teams are divided into four groups of four


Each group plays a GSL-style bracket


All matches are best of three


The top two teams of each group advance to the 
Main Event


Main Event


Swiss Stage


32 teams participate

24 teams prequalified + the 8 qualifiers of the 
LCQ


Swiss-style format with seven rounds


Qualification and Elimination matches are best of three, all other matches are best of one


Top 13 teams advance to Playoffs


The teams finishing in 14th to 16th place advance to the Knockout Matches


Knockout Matches


6 teams participate

3 EMEA teams from 
WSCI 2026


3 teams ranked 14th to 16th from Swiss Stage


All matches are best of five


3 teams advance to Playoffs


Playoffs


16 teams participate

13 teams from Swiss Stage


3 teams from Knockout Matches


Single elimination bracket


All matches are best of five

Format
[
]


Regional Merit Match
[
]


Two teams participate

The lowest-ranked guest team among the region with the most guest teams in the 
LCP 2025 Season Finals


In case all guest teams from that region qualify for 
Worlds 2025
, the second-lowest ranked guest team will participate in the Regional Merit Match.


In case that region has one team relegated for the Free For All, the second-lowest ranked guest team will participate in the Regional Merit Match.


In case all three guest teams (excluding the team participating in the Free For All) qualify for 
Worlds 2025
, this round will not take place. And FFA will change the format to fit 6 teams.


The regional champion from the same region as the relegated team under the Regional Merit system


Match is best of five


Winner qualifies for the 
LCP 2026 Season


Free for All Bracket
[
]


Five teams participate

The champions of the three regions that are not participating in the Regional Merit match


The lowest-ranked guest team from the 
LCP 2025 Season Finals


The champion of the 
LCP Wildcard 2025 Playoffs


The 
LCP
 guest team will get a bye to the 
Finals


Single elimination bracket


All matches are best of five


Winner qualifies for the 
LCP 2026 Season

The 
2026 
League of Legends
 Game Changers Rising
 ("
LGC Rising 2026
") is the second edition of the women-only 
League of Legends
 competition series hosted in collaboration between 
N.E.O.
 and 
Riot Games
 in the EMEA region.

Overview
[
]


Format
[
]


Swiss Stage
[
]


Up to 32 signed up teams participate


Swiss-style format with five rounds


All matches are best of one (Bo1)


Top 8 teams advance to the Playoffs


Playoffs
[
]


Top 8 teams from the Swiss Stage participate


Double Elimination Bracket


Round 1/Round 2 matches of Winners' Bracket and Round 3 match of Losers' Bracket are best of three (Bo3)


Round 1/Round 2 matches of Losers' Bracket are best of one (Bo1)


Round 3 match of Winners' Bracket is best of five (Bo5)

 ("

") is the second edition of the women-only 
League of Legends
 competition series hosted in collaboration between 
N.E.O.
 and 
Riot Games
 in the EMEA region.

Overview
[
]


Format
[
]


Swiss Stage
[
]


Up to 32 signed up teams participate


Swiss-style format with five rounds


All matches are best of one (Bo1)


Top 8 teams advance to the Playoffs


Playoffs
[
]


Top 8 teams from the Swiss Stage participate


Double Elimination Bracket


Round 1/Round 2 matches of Winners' Bracket and Round 3 match of Losers' Bracket are best of three (Bo3)


Round 1/Round 2 matches of Losers' Bracket are best of one (Bo1)


Round 3 match of Winners' Bracket is best of five (Bo5)

The 
Legends Academy
 (
LA
) is a semi-professional league organized by arrMY.

Overview
[
]


Format
[
]


16 teams from the 
Group Stage
 participate


Single Elimination Bracket, with a 3rd Place Match


Finals are best of five, all other matches are best of three


Playoffs features a draft system, called "Fearless Draft": teams may only pick any champion once in a series

Example: If 
Aatrox
 is picked by Team A in Game 1, Team A AND Team B can't pick him again for the rest of the series

The 
POP Esports Masters Season 6
 ("
PEM 2025
") represents the sixth year of the Luxembourg's largest semi-professional esports competition. In the League of Legends circuit, six teams fight in a double round-robin format for a chance to qualify for the tournament's final phase, where they will fight in a king-of-the-hill bracket to achieve regional glory and cash prizes.

Overview
[
]


Format
[
]


Six teams participate


Group Stage


Double Round Robin


All matches are best-of-one (BO1)


Top three teams qualify for the finals phase

Number one team is given a bye to the Grand Finals


Bottom two teams are sent down to relegation matches


Bracket Stage


Single Elimination


Matches are Best-of-Three (BO3)

The 
Techniker Prime League 2nd Division
 is the 2nd highest tier of the german ERL circuit. In previous seasons, it was known as the 1st Division.



Overview
[
]


Format
[
]


16 teams participate


2 groups of 8 teams


Matches are best of three

Teams gain 3 points for a 2-0 win, 2 points for a 2-1 win, 1 point for a 1-2 loss, and 0 points for a 0-2 loss


Single Round Robin


Top 6 teams advance to playoffs

Top 2 of each group advance directly


3rd and 4th place teams play decider matches for the remaining spots


Bottom 6 drop to relegation

Bottom team of each group drops directly


5th to 7th place teams play decider matches for the remaining spots

The 
Techniker Prime League 2nd Division
 is the 2nd highest tier of the german ERL circuit. In previous seasons, it was known as the 1st Division.



Overview
[
]


Format
[
]


16 teams participate


2 groups of 8 teams


Matches are best of three

Teams gain 3 points for a 2-0 win, 2 points for a 2-1 win, 1 point for a 1-2 loss, and 0 points for a 0-2 loss


Single Round Robin


Top 6 teams advance to playoffs

Top 2 of each group advance directly


3rd and 4th place teams play decider matches for the remaining spots


Bottom 6 drop to relegation

Bottom team of each group drops directly


5th to 7th place teams play decider matches for the remaining spots

The 
2026 Season World Championship Main Event (Worlds 2026 Main Event)
 is the conclusion of the 2026 
League of Legends
 esports season.

Overview
[
]


Format
[
]


Stage 2 (Swiss)


16 teams participate

15 teams prequalified for Swiss Stage + the 1 qualifier of 
Play-In


Swiss-style format with five rounds

Rematches within Swiss Stage are not permitted


Matchups will be drawn at the end of each round


Teams with three wins advance to Stage 3, while teams with three losses are eliminated


Qualification and Elimination matches are best of three; all other matches are best of one


Stage 3 (Knockout)


Eight qualifiers from Stage 2 participate


Single elimination bracket


Matches are best of five

 is the conclusion of the 2026 
League of Legends
 esports season. The tournament will be held in the United States.

Stage 1 (Play-In)


4 teams participate


Double elimination bracket


All matches are best of five


Winner advances to Stage 2


Stage 2 (Swiss)


16 teams participate

15 teams prequalified for Stage 2 + the qualifier of Stage 1


Swiss-style format with five rounds

Rematches within Swiss Stage are not permitted


Matchups will be drawn at the end of each round


Teams with three wins advance to Stage 3, while teams with three losses are eliminated


Qualification and Elimination matches are best of three; all other matches are best of one


Stage 3 (Knockout)


Eight qualifiers from Stage 2 participate


Single elimination bracket


Matches are best of five
